channel.title: HighLevel guides by Saad Bin Yousaf
channel.description: Independent guides to HighLevel (GoHighLevel) by a HighLevel systems builder: what it does, what it costs and how to set it up properly.

item.title: HighLevel Workflow Maps: See Every Automation in One Map
item.description: HighLevel's new Workflow Maps draws a live map of every workflow and what it touches. What it shows, who gets it, and five jobs it makes easier.

item.title: HighLevel AI Video Generation: Workflows and AI Agents That Make Videos
item.description: GoHighLevel can now generate videos in workflows and through AI agents. The three ways to do it, the limits and what it costs per second.

item.title: GoHighLevel Free Trial: 14 Days or 30, and How to Use Them
item.description: GoHighLevel has a 14-day free trial and a 30-day one. How each works, what's still charged, how to cancel and a 7-day plan to test it properly.

item.title: HighLevel AI Explained: Every AI Tool and What It's For
item.description: A plain map of GoHighLevel's AI: which tool talks to customers, which helps you work, which are free or paid, and where to start.

item.title: HighLevel AI Pricing: Pay-Per-Use vs AI Employee Plans
item.description: What GoHighLevel AI costs: pay-per-use rates, the $20, $50 and $97 AI Employee plans, what no plan includes and which fits your volume.

item.title: HighLevel Ask AI: What It Can Do and How to Use It Well
item.description: Ask AI is GoHighLevel's built-in assistant that acts inside your account. What it can and can't do, who pays, and 12 prompts to copy.

item.title: How to Set Up HighLevel Conversation AI Without Embarrassing Yourself
item.description: Set up a HighLevel Conversation AI bot that answers questions and books appointments: knowledge base, goals, Suggestive vs Auto-Pilot, testing and costs.

item.title: HighLevel Voice AI Setup: Build an AI Receptionist That Answers Your Calls
item.description: Set up a GoHighLevel Voice AI agent that answers calls, books appointments and transfers to a person. Prompt, actions, testing and cost per minute.

item.title: Missed Call Text Back in GoHighLevel: Setup, Wording and Fixes
item.description: Set up missed call text back in GoHighLevel: where the setting is, 5 message templates, how to stop duplicate texts and fixes when it won't send.

item.title: HighLevel Managed Agents and Agent Studio: A Plain-English Guide
item.description: Managed Agents are AI workers you build by describing the job. How they differ from workflows and Conversation AI, how to start, and run costs.

item.title: HighLevel LevelUp 2026: The Updates Worth Your Attention
item.description: HighLevel announced a long list of features at LevelUp 2026. The ones that matter for most accounts, sorted by whether you can use them today.

item.title: What Is GoHighLevel? A Complete Beginner's Guide
item.description: What HighLevel does, who it's built for, how its tools fit together, what it costs and when a different tool is the better choice.

item.title: GoHighLevel Pricing Explained: Which Plan Is Right for You?
item.description: GoHighLevel pricing explained: the $97, $297 and $497 plans, annual prices, the usage charges on top and which plan fits you.

item.title: How to Set Up GoHighLevel: A Step-by-Step Beginner's Guide
item.description: Set up a new GoHighLevel account in the right order: domain, email and SMS sending, pipeline, calendar, form and first workflow. With checklists.
